texts.orig: A Day I Will Never Forget
texts.text: A Day I Will Never Forget

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Last summer, I decided to spend a weekend in a small mountain village because I wanted to escape the noise of the city. I had always enjoyed visiting quiet places, and I hoped to relax, to explore the area, and to forget about work for a few days.
texts.text: Last summer, I decided to spend a weekend in a small mountain village because I wanted to escape the noise of the city. I had always enjoyed visiting quiet places, and I hoped to relax, to explore the area, and to forget about work for a few days.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When I arrived, the owner of the guest house let me leave my bags in my room before checking in. She suggested walking to a nearby lake and warned me not to go too far into the forest. I promised to be careful, but I was too excited to listen properly.
texts.text: When I arrived, the owner of the guest house let me leave my bags in my room before checking in. She suggested walking to a nearby lake and warned me not to go too far into the forest. I promised to be careful, but I was too excited to listen properly.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: I started following a narrow path through the trees. I loved hearing the birds, watching the sunlight move through the leaves, and breathing the fresh mountain air. After walking for nearly an hour, I stopped to drink some water. That was when I realised that I had forgotten to bring my phone.

After walking for nearly an hour, I stopped to drink some water. That was when I realised that I had forgotten to bring my phone.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: I considered turning back, but I decided to continue. I wanted to reach the lake before sunset, and I thought I could find the way without using a map. However, the path suddenly disappeared, and I became completely lost.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A few minutes later, I heard someone calling for help. I followed the voice and found a young man sitting beside a fallen tree. He had injured his ankle and could not stand up. I offered to help him, and together we tried to find the main path. He suggested climbing a small hill so that we could see the village, but his ankle was too painful to move.
texts.text: A few minutes later, I heard someone calling for help. I followed the voice and found a young man sitting beside a fallen tree. He had injured his ankle and could not stand up. I offered to help him, and together we tried to find the main path. He suggested climbing a small hill so that we could see the village, but his ankle was too painful to move.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: I told him to stay where he was while I went to look for help. I had never felt so frightened, but I forced myself to remain calm. After walking for another twenty minutes, I saw a small cabin. An elderly woman opened the door and let me use her phone. She called the emergency services and asked me to explain exactly where the injured man was.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The rescue team arrived quickly. They made me show them the way, and soon the young man was found and taken to hospital. I was exhausted, relieved, and amazed that everything had ended safely.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Since that day, I have stopped going into unfamiliar places without taking a phone or a map. I have also learned to follow advice instead of assuming that nothing will go wrong. That experience taught me to be more responsible, and I will never forget helping someone when they truly needed me.
